source.text: אַל־תִּשְׂמַ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל׀אֶל־גִּיל֙ כָּֽעַמִּ֔ים כִּ֥י זָנִ֖יתָ מֵעַ֣ל אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אָהַ֣בְתָּ אֶתְנָ֔ן עַ֖ל כָּל־גָּרְנ֥וֹת דָּגָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not rejoice, Israel, to exultation like the peoples, for you have prostituted yourself from upon your God; you have loved a fee on all threshing floors of grain.

en.L: Do not rejoice, Israel, to exultation like the peoples, \q for you have prostituted yourself away from your God; \q you have loved a prostitute's fee \q on every threshing floor of grain.
en.B: Do not rejoice, Israel; do not exult like the other nations, \q for you have prostituted yourself and left your God. \q You have loved a prostitute's pay \q on every threshing floor heaped with grain.
en.R: Israel, do not celebrate with joy as other nations do, \q for you have been unfaithful to your God. \q You have loved the pay a prostitute earns \q at every threshing floor full of grain.

es.L: No te alegres, Israel, hasta el júbilo como los pueblos, \q porque te has prostituido apartándote de tu Dios; \q has amado la paga de prostituta \q en todas las eras de grano.
es.B: No te alegres, Israel; no te regocijes como las otras naciones, \q porque te has prostituido y has dejado a tu Dios. \q Has amado la paga de una prostituta \q en cada era llena de grano.
es.R: Israel, no celebres con alegría como lo hacen otras naciones, \q porque has sido infiel a tu Dios. \q Has amado la paga que gana una prostituta \q en cada era llena de grano.

fr.L: Ne te réjouis pas, Israël, jusqu’à l’exultation comme les peuples, \q car tu t’es prostitué loin de ton Dieu ; \q tu as aimé le salaire de la prostituée \q sur toutes les aires de blé.
fr.B: Ne te réjouis pas, Israël ; n’exulte pas comme les autres nations, \q car tu t’es prostitué et tu as abandonné ton Dieu. \q Tu as aimé le salaire de la prostitution \q sur toutes les aires chargées de blé.
fr.R: Israël, ne fais pas la fête avec joie comme les autres nations, \q car tu as été infidèle à ton Dieu. \q Tu as aimé l’argent que gagne une prostituée \q sur toutes les aires de battage pleines de blé.

sw.L: Usifurahi, Israeli, hata kushangilia kama mataifa, \q kwa maana umefanya ukahaba ukimwacha Mungu wako; \q umependa ujira wa kahaba \q juu ya kila uwanja wa kupuria nafaka.
sw.B: Usifurahi, Israeli; usishangilie kama mataifa mengine, \q kwa maana umefanya ukahaba na kumwacha Mungu wako. \q Umependa malipo ya kahaba \q katika kila uwanja wa kupuria uliojaa nafaka.
sw.R: Israeli, usisherehekee kwa furaha kama mataifa mengine, \q kwa maana hukuwa mwaminifu kwa Mungu wako. \q Umependa malipo anayopata kahaba \q katika kila uwanja wa kupuria uliojaa nafaka.

vi.L: Chớ vui mừng, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, đến mức hớn hở như các dân, \q vì ngươi đã làm điếm mà lìa bỏ Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi; \q ngươi đã ưa thích tiền công của gái điếm \q trên mọi sân đập lúa.
vi.B: Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, đừng vui mừng; đừng hớn hở như các dân khác, \q vì ngươi đã làm điếm và lìa bỏ Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi. \q Ngươi đã ưa thích tiền công của gái điếm \q trên mọi sân đập lúa chất đầy ngũ cốc.
vi.R: Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, đừng vui mừng hớn hở như các dân khác, \q vì ngươi đã bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi. \q Ngươi đã ưa thích tiền công mà gái mại dâm kiếm được \q tại mọi sân đập lúa đầy ngũ cốc.

ko.L: 이스라엘아, 기뻐하지 마라. 민족들처럼 크게 즐거워하지 마라. \q 네가 음행하여 네 하나님을 떠났기 때문이다. \q 너는 곡식 타작마당마다에서 \q 몸값을 좋아했다.
ko.B: 이스라엘아, 기뻐하지 마라. 다른 민족들처럼 즐거워 날뛰지 마라. \q 너는 음행하여 네 하나님을 떠났다. \q 너는 곡식이 쌓인 타작마당마다에서 \q 화대를 좋아했다.
ko.R: 이스라엘아, 다른 민족들처럼 기뻐하며 즐거워하지 마라. \q 너는 네 하나님께 신실하지 않았다. \q 너는 곡식이 가득한 타작마당마다에서 \q 창녀가 받는 값을 좋아했다.

decisions.choice: to exultation: do not rejoice to the point of exulting like the peoples
alternatives: do not exult (reading the word for "to" as "not")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "do not rejoice ... to exultation", an unusual way of saying "do not rejoice and exult". The Greek translation (the Septuagint) reads a second "do not" here: "do not rejoice and do not exult". The two words differ by one letter in Hebrew, and the sense is the same either way: Israel must not celebrate as the other nations do.

decisions.choice: you have prostituted yourself away from your God: you have been unfaithful to God by worshiping other gods
decisions.reason: Hosea pictures Israel as the LORD's wife who has left him for lovers (2:4-15; 4:12). "From upon your God" means turning away from him, as a wife leaves her husband. The unfaithfulness is the worship of Baal, which the next words tie to the harvest.

decisions.choice: a prostitute's fee on every threshing floor: the harvest taken as payment from Baal
decisions.reason: Grain was threshed on open floors, and the harvest was a time of feasting. In 2:7 and 2:14 Israel says that her lovers gave her bread, wool and vines as her pay, when in fact the LORD gave them (2:10). The grain on the threshing floors is the "fee" Israel loved: the reward she believed she earned by serving Baal, the god thought to send rain and crops.

decisions.choice: prostituted yourself (L, B); been unfaithful (R)
decisions.reason: The verb follows the wording settled for Hosea: "prostitute oneself" at Literal and Balanced, "be unfaithful" at Readable (as Judges 2:17).

decisions.choice: "la paga de prostituta"; "era"
decisions.reason: The prostitute's fee is said plainly at every level, as the terms note sets; "era" is the threshing floor, as in the published Spanish (Ruth 3; 2 Samuel 24).

decisions.choice: masculine agreement for Israel addressed here ("tu t'es prostitué")
alternatives: feminine, as Israel the wife of chapter 2
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is masculine here; Israel is "elle" only where Hosea pictures the nation as God's wife (chapter 2), as the term sheet says.

decisions.choice: "네 하나님께" (R) with 께
decisions.reason: The speaker here is the prophet addressing Israel (God is "your God" in the third person), so the honorific particle is used.

source.text: גֹּ֥רֶן וָיֶ֖קֶב לֹ֣א יִרְעֵ֑ם וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יְכַ֥חֶשׁ בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Threshing floor and winepress not will feed them, and new wine will fail in her.

en.L: Threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, \q and new wine will fail her.
en.B: Neither threshing floor nor winepress will feed them, \q and the new wine will let her down.
en.R: But the grain and the grapes will not feed them, \q and the new wine will run out.

es.L: La era y el lagar no los alimentarán, \q y el mosto le fallará.
es.B: Ni la era ni el lagar los alimentarán, \q y el vino nuevo le fallará.
es.R: Pero el grano y las uvas no los alimentarán, \q y el vino nuevo se acabará.

fr.L: L’aire et le pressoir ne les nourriront pas, \q et le vin nouveau lui fera défaut.
fr.B: Ni l’aire ni le pressoir ne les nourriront, \q et le vin nouveau la décevra.
fr.R: Mais le blé et le raisin ne les nourriront pas, \q et le vin nouveau viendra à manquer.

sw.L: Uwanja wa kupuria na shinikizo havitawalisha, \q na divai mpya itampungukia.
sw.B: Wala uwanja wa kupuria wala shinikizo la divai havitawalisha, \q na divai mpya itamwangusha.
sw.R: Lakini nafaka na zabibu hazitawalisha, \q na divai mpya itakwisha.

vi.L: Sân đập lúa và bồn ép nho sẽ không nuôi chúng, \q và rượu mới sẽ phụ nàng.
vi.B: Cả sân đập lúa lẫn bồn ép nho sẽ không nuôi nổi chúng, \q và rượu mới sẽ làm nàng thất vọng.
vi.R: Nhưng lúa và nho sẽ không đủ nuôi chúng, \q và rượu mới sẽ cạn hết.

ko.L: 타작마당과 포도주 틀이 그들을 먹이지 못하고, \q 새 포도주가 그 여자를 저버릴 것이다.
ko.B: 타작마당도 포도주 틀도 그들을 먹이지 못하고, \q 새 포도주도 그 여자를 실망시킬 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 곡식과 포도가 그들을 먹여 살리지 못할 것이다. \q 새 포도주도 떨어질 것이다.

decisions.choice: threshing floor and winepress: the grain harvest and the grape harvest will fail
decisions.reason: The threshing floor stands for the grain and the winepress for the wine, the two great harvests of the year. The gifts Israel credited to Baal (verse 1; 2:7) will be taken away, as 2:11 warns: "I will take back my grain in its time and my new wine in its season."

decisions.choice: her: Israel, pictured as the unfaithful wife
alternatives: it: the land
decisions.reason: The verse moves from "them" (the people) to "her", the wife of verse 1 and of chapter 2. The new wine she counted on will let her down. The pronoun could also mean the land, which is feminine in Hebrew, but the wife fits the picture of verse 1.

decisions.choice: the grain and the grapes
decisions.reason: Readable names what the threshing floor and the winepress produce, so the reader sees that the harvests themselves will fail (m1). It leaves out "her" and says simply that the wine will run out.

source.text: לֹ֥א יֵשְׁב֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוָ֑ה וְשָׁ֤ב אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּבְאַשּׁ֖וּר טָמֵ֥א יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not they will remain in [the] land of Yahweh, and will return Ephraim [to] Egypt, and in Assyria unclean [food] they will eat.

en.L: They will not dwell in the land of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q Ephraim will turn back to Egypt, \q and in Assyria they will eat unclean [food].
en.B: They will not stay in the land of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Ephraim will go back to Egypt, \q and in Assyria they will eat unclean food.
en.R: They will not go on living in the land of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q The people of Ephraim will go back to Egypt. \q In Assyria they will eat food that is unclean.

es.L: No habitarán en la tierra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q Efraín volverá a Egipto, \q y en Asiria comerán [comida] impura.
es.B: No se quedarán en la tierra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q Efraín volverá a Egipto, \q y en Asiria comerán alimentos impuros.
es.R: No seguirán viviendo en la tierra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q El pueblo de Efraín volverá a Egipto. \q En Asiria comerán alimentos impuros.

fr.L: Ils ne demeureront pas dans le pays {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; \q Éphraïm reviendra en Égypte, \q et en Assyrie ils mangeront [des aliments] impurs.
fr.B: Ils ne resteront pas dans le pays {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q Éphraïm reviendra en Égypte, \q et en Assyrie ils mangeront des aliments impurs.
fr.R: Ils ne continueront pas à vivre dans le pays {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q Le peuple d’Éphraïm reviendra en Égypte. \q En Assyrie, ils mangeront de la nourriture impure.

sw.L: Hawatakaa katika nchi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q Efraimu atarudi Misri, \q na katika Ashuru watakula [chakula] najisi.
sw.B: Hawatabaki katika nchi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Efraimu atarudi Misri, \q na katika Ashuru watakula chakula najisi.
sw.R: Hawataendelea kuishi katika nchi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Watu wa Efraimu watarudi Misri. \q Huko Ashuru watakula chakula kilicho najisi.

vi.L: Chúng sẽ không ở lại trong đất của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q Ép-ra-im sẽ trở về Ai Cập, \q và tại A-si-ri chúng sẽ ăn [đồ] ô uế.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ không được ở lại trong đất của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Ép-ra-im sẽ trở lại Ai Cập, \q và tại A-si-ri chúng sẽ ăn đồ ăn ô uế.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ không còn được sống trong đất của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Dân Ép-ra-im sẽ trở lại Ai Cập. \q Tại A-si-ri, chúng sẽ ăn thức ăn ô uế.

ko.L: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 땅에 살지 못할 것이다. \q 에브라임은 이집트로 돌아가고, \q 앗시리아에서 부정한 [음식을] 먹을 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 땅에 머물지 못할 것이다. \q 에브라임은 이집트로 돌아가고, \q 앗시리아에서 부정한 음식을 먹을 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 땅에서 계속 살지 못할 것이다. \q 에브라임 백성은 이집트로 돌아갈 것이다. \q 앗시리아에서 그들은 부정한 음식을 먹을 것이다.

decisions.choice: Ephraim: the northern kingdom of Israel
decisions.reason: Ephraim, the largest tribe of the north, stands for the whole northern kingdom in Hosea (see 4:17). Here it is parallel with "they", the people who will lose the land.

decisions.choice: return to Egypt: the exodus undone, a return to bondage
alternatives: a literal flight of refugees to Egypt only
decisions.reason: God brought Israel up out of Egypt (2:17; 11:1; 12:10). To "return to Egypt" is to go back to where the story began, into slavery (8:13). In 11:5 Hosea says that Ephraim will not return to Egypt, but Assyria will be his king, so here Egypt is partly a picture of bondage, set beside the real threat of Assyria. Some did flee to Egypt (verse 6).

decisions.choice: unclean food: food that cannot be offered to God or eaten as holy
decisions.reason: A foreign land was counted unclean (Amos 7:17; Ezekiel 4:13), because no offering to the LORD could be made there and no firstfruits brought to his house. In exile everything Israel ate would be unclean in this sense (verse 4).

decisions.choice: unclean [food]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "unclean"; Literal supplies "food" in brackets.

source.text: לֹא־יִסְּכ֨וּ לַיהוָ֥ה׀יַיִן֮ וְלֹ֣א יֶֽעֶרְבוּ־לוֹ֒ זִבְחֵיהֶ֗ם כְּלֶ֤חֶם אוֹנִים֙ לָהֶ֔ם כָּל־אֹכְלָ֖יו יִטַמָּ֑אוּכִּֽי־לַחְמָ֣ם לְנַפְשָׁ֔ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not they will pour out to Yahweh wine, and not they will be pleasing to him their sacrifices; like bread of mourners to them; all eating it will make themselves unclean; for their bread [is] for their appetite; not it will come [into the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: They will not pour out wine to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and their sacrifices will not please {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q [they will be] to them like mourners' bread; \q all who eat it will make themselves unclean. \q For their bread [will be] for their appetite; \q it will not go into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: They will pour out no wine offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and their sacrifices will give {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} no pleasure. \q They will be like mourners' bread to them; \q all who eat it will become unclean. \q Their bread will be for their own hunger; \q it will not come into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: In exile they will not pour out wine as an offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and their sacrifices will not please {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Their sacrifices will be like food eaten at a funeral: \q everyone who eats it will be unclean. \q Their food will only fill their stomachs. \q None of it will be brought into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: No derramarán vino {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y sus sacrificios no {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agradarán; \q [serán] para ellos como pan de duelo; \q todos los que lo coman se contaminarán. \q Porque su pan [será] para su apetito; \q no entrará en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: No derramarán ofrendas de vino {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y sus sacrificios no {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} darán ningún agrado. \q Serán para ellos como pan de duelo; \q todos los que lo coman quedarán impuros. \q Su pan será solo para su propia hambre; \q no entrará en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: En el destierro no derramarán vino como ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y sus sacrificios no {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agradarán. \q Sus sacrificios serán como la comida de un funeral: \q todo el que la coma quedará impuro. \q Su comida solo les llenará el estómago. \q Nada de ella se llevará a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Ils ne verseront pas de vin {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et leurs sacrifices ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plairont pas ; \q [ils seront] pour eux comme le pain des endeuillés ; \q tous ceux qui en mangent se rendront impurs. \q Car leur pain [sera] pour leur appétit ; \q il n’entrera pas dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ils ne verseront plus de vin en offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et leurs sacrifices ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} feront pas plaisir. \q Ils seront pour eux comme le pain des endeuillés ; \q tous ceux qui en mangeront deviendront impurs. \q Leur pain servira à leur propre faim ; \q il n’entrera pas dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: En exil, ils ne verseront pas de vin en offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et leurs sacrifices ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plairont pas. \q Leurs sacrifices seront comme la nourriture d’un repas de deuil : \q tous ceux qui en mangeront seront impurs. \q Leur nourriture remplira seulement leur estomac. \q Rien n’en sera apporté dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Hawatammiminia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} divai, wala dhabihu zao hazitampendeza; \q [zitakuwa] kwao kama mkate wa waombolezaji; \q wote wanaoula watajitia unajisi. \q Kwa maana mkate wao [utakuwa] kwa ajili ya hamu yao; \q hautaingia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Hawatammiminia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} divai kama sadaka, wala dhabihu zao hazitampendeza. \q Zitakuwa kwao kama mkate wa waombolezaji; \q wote watakaoula watakuwa najisi. \q Mkate wao utakuwa kwa ajili ya njaa yao wenyewe; \q hautaingia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Wakiwa uhamishoni hawatammiminia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} divai kama sadaka, wala dhabihu zao hazitampendeza. \q Dhabihu zao zitakuwa kama chakula kinacholiwa msibani: \q kila atakayekila atakuwa najisi. \q Chakula chao kitajaza matumbo yao tu. \q Hakuna hata kidogo kitakacholetwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Chúng sẽ không rót rượu dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và các sinh tế của chúng sẽ không đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q [chúng sẽ] như bánh của người có tang đối với chúng; \q mọi kẻ ăn bánh ấy sẽ tự làm mình ô uế. \q Vì bánh của chúng [sẽ là] cho cơn thèm của chúng; \q nó sẽ không vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ không còn rót rượu làm lễ quán dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và các sinh tế của chúng sẽ không làm đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Các sinh tế ấy sẽ như bánh của nhà có tang đối với chúng; \q mọi kẻ ăn sẽ bị ô uế. \q Bánh của chúng chỉ để cho cơn đói của chúng; \q nó sẽ không được đem vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Khi bị lưu đày, chúng sẽ không rót rượu dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và các sinh tế của chúng sẽ không đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Sinh tế của chúng sẽ như thức ăn trong đám tang: \q ai ăn cũng bị ô uế. \q Thức ăn của chúng chỉ để no bụng mà thôi. \q Không chút nào được đem vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 포도주를 부어 드리지 못하고, 그들의 제물이 그분을 기쁘시게 하지 못할 것이다. \q [그 제물은] 그들에게 초상집 빵 같을 것이다. \q 그것을 먹는 사람은 모두 더러워질 것이다. \q 그들의 빵은 그들의 배를 [채울] 뿐이고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어가지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 포도주를 부어 바치지 못하고, 그들의 제물은 그분을 기쁘시게 하지 못할 것이다. \q 그 제물은 그들에게 초상집 빵과 같아서, \q 그것을 먹는 사람은 모두 부정하게 될 것이다. \q 그들의 빵은 자기들의 배고픔을 채울 뿐, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에는 들어가지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 포로로 끌려가서는 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 포도주를 부어 바치지 못할 것이다. 그들의 제물도 그분을 기쁘시게 하지 못할 것이다. \q 그들의 제물은 장례 때 먹는 음식과 같을 것이다. \q 그것을 먹는 사람은 누구나 부정하게 된다. \q 그들의 음식은 그저 배만 채울 것이다. \q 그 가운데 아무것도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 바쳐지지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: pour out wine: the drink offering
decisions.reason: Wine was poured out to the LORD with the daily and festival offerings (Exodus 29:40; Numbers 15:5-10). In exile there will be no altar and no offerings.

decisions.choice: their sacrifices will not please him; the sacrifices are then compared to mourners' bread
alternatives: and they will not bring their sacrifices to please him
decisions.reason: "Their sacrifices" stands between "will not please him" and "like mourners' bread", and it serves both: the sacrifices will not please God, and they will be to the people like the bread of mourners.

decisions.choice: mourners' bread: food made unclean by contact with the dead
decisions.reason: Anyone in a house where someone had died was unclean for seven days (Numbers 19:14), and food eaten while mourning could not be given to God (Deuteronomy 26:14). Israel's food in exile will be like that: it can feed them but never be offered.

decisions.choice: for their appetite: their bread will only feed their hunger
alternatives: for themselves
decisions.reason: The word often translated "soul" also means throat and appetite. Their bread will serve only to keep them alive; none of it will come into the LORD's house as an offering.

decisions.choice: In exile ... food eaten at a funeral
decisions.reason: Readable says where this will happen (in exile, from verse 3) and explains "mourners' bread" as food eaten where someone has died (m3).

records.literal_gloss: What will you do on [the] day of appointed feast, and on [the] day of the festival of Yahweh?

en.L: What will you do on the day of the appointed feast, \q and on the day of the festival of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?
en.B: What will you do on the day of the appointed festival, \q on the day of the feast of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?
en.R: What will you do when the day of the appointed festival comes, \q the day of the feast of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?

es.L: ¿Qué {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} en el día de la fiesta señalada, \q y en el día de la fiesta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?
es.B: ¿Qué {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} en el día de la fiesta solemne, \q en el día de la fiesta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?
es.R: ¿Qué {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} cuando llegue el día de la fiesta solemne, \q el día de la fiesta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?

fr.L: Que ferez-vous au jour de la solennité, \q et au jour de la fête {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ?
fr.B: Que ferez-vous au jour de l’assemblée solennelle, \q au jour de la fête {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ?
fr.R: Que ferez-vous quand arrivera le jour de la fête prévue, \q le jour de la fête {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ?

sw.L: Mtafanya nini katika siku ya sikukuu iliyoamriwa, \q na katika siku ya sikukuu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?
sw.B: Mtafanya nini siku ya sikukuu iliyoamriwa, \q siku ya sherehe ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?
sw.R: Mtafanya nini siku ya sikukuu iliyopangwa itakapofika, \q siku ya sherehe ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ làm gì trong ngày lễ đã định, \q và trong ngày lễ hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?
vi.B: Các ngươi sẽ làm gì trong ngày lễ đã định, \q trong ngày đại lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ làm gì khi đến ngày lễ đã định, \q ngày đại lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?

ko.L: 정한 절기의 날에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 절기의 날에 너희가 무엇을 하겠느냐?
ko.B: 정한 절기의 날에, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 축제일에 너희가 무엇을 하겠느냐?
ko.R: 정한 절기가 되면 너희가 무엇을 하겠느냐? \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 축제일에 무엇을 하겠느냐?

decisions.choice: the appointed festival, the feast of the LORD: Israel's yearly pilgrim feasts
decisions.reason: The appointed times were the festivals of Israel's calendar (Leviticus 23), and "the feast of the LORD" was the great yearly feast (Leviticus 23:39; Judges 21:19), probably the autumn harvest feast of Booths. Hosea's words about harvest and threshing floors (verses 1-2) fit that feast, but the text does not name it.

decisions.choice: What will you do? A question that expects no answer: in exile the feasts cannot be kept
decisions.reason: The question follows from verse 4. Far from the land and the LORD's house, the people will have no way to celebrate the days that marked their year.
